# Neon Synthwave

Neon Synthwave is a dark theme with vibrant purple, pink and cyan accents. The editor, panes and interface elements carry retro 80s gradients and glowing highlights.

![Neon Synthwave screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/grjsmith/Neon-Synthwave/HEAD/screenshot.jpg)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Neon Synthwave"
    author: "grjsmith"
    repo:   "grjsmith/Neon-Synthwave"
    slug:   "neon-synthwave"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/neon-synthwave"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/grjsmith/Neon-Synthwave"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/grjsmith/Neon-Synthwave/HEAD/screenshot.jpg"

    modes: ["dark"]
    about: "Give Obsidian a neon synthwave aesthetic with vibrant purple, pink, and cyan accents on dark backgrounds. Style the editor, panes, and UI elements with retro 80s gradients and glowing highlights for a cohesive, nostalgic interface."
}
```
